name: ammonite_spiral
theme: an iridescent ammonite fossil on a dusk tide-pool shore opens into its own nacre chambers and aragonite terraces, folds out to a barred spiral galaxy, and comes home down the coastline

registers.name: tidepool_shore
registers.scene: a wide rocky tide-pool shore at dusk seen from a low headland, dark slate ledges wet from the tide, shallow pools and ribbons of cream foam between them, kelp and barnacle crust in the cracks, one coiled fossil shell set in a flat slab at the water's edge
registers.target: a coiled fossil shell, ribbed spiral whorls of pale stone, a faint oil-slick sheen
registers.loop_target: the wide rocky tide-pool shore at dusk seen from a low headland, dark slate ledges, shallow pools and ribbons of cream foam

registers.name: ammonite
registers.scene: a coiled ammonite fossil set in a flat slate slab, ribbed whorls of pale stone wound tight to a small centre, a thin film of pearl iridescence over the ribs, dark slate matrix around the rim
registers.target: an open pearl-white chamber, its curved partition edged in branching frilled lace

registers.name: nacre_chamber
registers.scene: the inside of one ammonite chamber, a curved pearl-white partition wall across it, its edge a dense lace of branching frilled lobes, fine ridges fanned across the ivory surface, more chambers open beyond the wall, a thin oil-slick film of colour over everything
registers.target: a stepped ledge of aragonite crystal, flat pale tiers bright with green and pink colour

registers.name: aragonite_terraces
registers.scene: a wide field of stepped aragonite terraces, flat crystal tiers stacked in broad level shelves, straight sharp edges dividing the levels, further shelves stacked away behind them, green and violet iridescence washed across the flat faces

registers.name: barred_galaxy
registers.scene: a barred spiral galaxy in the black, a broad glowing bar of amber starlight across its core, two great arms curved out from the bar's ends, dark dust lanes threading between them
registers.target: a dense knot of stars, a tight cluster of cream points

registers.name: star_lattice
registers.scene: a dense field of stars set in interlocking curved rows, thousands of silver-blue points in a tight seed-pattern lattice, faint violet gas in the gaps between them
registers.target: a pearl-white planet, one broad white cloud band wound around it

registers.name: pearl_planet
registers.scene: a huge pearl-white planet hanging in space, one enormous white cloud system coiled across its face, warm gold light along its curved limb, the black of space beyond
registers.target: a clear round opening in the white cloud

registers.name: coastline
registers.scene: a rugged coastline seen from high above, dark slate headlands and long reefs edged with cream surf, pale tide flats and scattered pools between the rocks, deep green water in the bays

music_theme: a tidal iridescent hush — slow shimmering bells over a deep ocean swell, one bright crystalline bloom landing on the crystal-terrace-to-galaxy seam
